W.note: Clean pill with a full timeline, next-step hint and carrier link, but the Copy number button wraps awkwardly and the open state is tall.

X.note: Collapsed card shows item, status and ETA with a progress bar, and opening adds package tabs, carrier, tracking number, timeline and actions in a tight, polished layout.

Y.note: Very small, but the ETA is truncated to Arrive… when collapsed, the tracking number and carrier name wrap, and there is no progress or next-step cue.

Z.note: Dense and readable with a progress bar, 5 of 6 count and ETA, but the open panel has dead space at the bottom, the chevron is a tiny glyph, and the status is not announced.
